parameters.parameter_family: team count, roster size, half-PPR scoring, rookie-draft rounds and lineup constraints
parameters.source: FSFFL league configuration and NFL rules
parameters.update_policy: Update only when league/NFL rules change

parameters.parameter_family: player scoring means and source weights
parameters.source: Current external projection source(s), recalculated under FSFFL scoring
parameters.validation: Required: rolling historical out-of-sample source/ensemble accuracy by position and horizon
parameters.uncertainty: Not yet demonstrated for projection mean layer
parameters.update_policy: Re-estimate source weights when new completed-season/week evidence is available; promote only on holdout improvement

parameters.source: Historical NFL weekly outcomes where implemented
parameters.validation: Required: calibration/coverage tests by position and forecast horizon
parameters.uncertainty: Must be measured rather than inferred from software-test success
parameters.update_policy: Rolling recalibration with new seasons; challenger must improve distributional calibration

parameters.parameter_family: current production, future value, liquidity and resilience weights
parameters.source: Embedded legacy anchors when calibration artifact is absent
parameters.validation: Required: real training artifact plus temporal/holdout validation and sensitivity analysis
parameters.update_policy: Replace legacy anchors only with versioned calibration that improves holdout performance

parameters.source: Current hard-coded rank curve layered on external market values
parameters.validation: Required: FSFFL completed-trade residuals versus contemporaneous market values, tested out of sample
parameters.uncertainty: risk of double counting market scarcity/consolidation
parameters.update_policy: Estimate residual league-specific curve only if stable predictive improvement is demonstrated

parameters.component: Strategic valuation adjustments inherited by GM 3.0
parameters.parameter_family: need, preference, window, endowment, starter/depth, performance, usage, injury and utility adjustments
parameters.validation: Required: family-by-family ablation and held-out prediction/decision testing
parameters.uncertainty: unknown incremental value; correlated inputs may double count
parameters.update_policy: Shrink/remove families lacking incremental validation; recalibrate surviving families from versioned evidence

parameters.parameter_family: future discount, tier multipliers, pick-slot scenarios, uncertainty growth and own-pick control
parameters.source: Current hard-coded GM 3.0 pick economics plus historical draft artifacts
parameters.validation: Required: FSFFL rookie-draft outcomes and contemporaneous dynasty-market backtest; separate market discount from expected-player-value uncertainty
parameters.update_policy: Annual versioned recalibration after rookie-draft and season outcomes; promote only on holdout improvement

parameters.parameter_family: effective value weights for second/third assets and consolidation effects
parameters.validation: Required: estimate from FSFFL completed trades; use broader dynasty trade data only as a fallback and validate mapping
parameters.update_policy: Version and refit as transaction sample grows; promotion requires held-out transaction fit improvement

parameters.validation: Required: compare heuristic cut choice to exhaustive/top-k post-cut roster optimization
parameters.uncertainty: can change simulated roster and verdict when a trade forces cuts
parameters.update_policy: Prefer exact/top-k resolution where computationally feasible; recalibrate only if heuristic remains necessary

parameters.parameter_family: pair insurance, capture scale, portfolio adjustment and acceptance-fit shift
parameters.validation: Required: historical lineup-availability and/or simulated replacement-outcome estimation
parameters.update_policy: Retain as qualified functionality while bounded; replace with versioned empirical estimates when validated

parameters.parameter_family: source weights, smoothing, need floor, residual scaling and confidence curve
parameters.source: Current behavioral constants and observed manager actions
parameters.validation: Required: time-ordered held-out manager-action prediction versus simple baselines plus ablations
parameters.uncertainty: manager samples are sparse and non-stationary
parameters.update_policy: Re-estimate on new manager actions with recency-aware validation; only promote if held-out ranking/log-loss improves

parameters.parameter_family: package limits, plausibility thresholds, value-ratio bands, protected-asset penalties, need bonuses and top-N pools
parameters.validation: Required: recall against exhaustive search on tractable historical/test universes
parameters.uncertainty: false negatives can be invisible downstream
parameters.update_policy: Tune for high recall first; version thresholds and require recall non-regression

parameters.parameter_family: championship-probability and value thresholds for accept/lean/reject
parameters.validation: Required: simulation-error-aware calibration and historical decision/outcome testing
parameters.uncertainty: threshold width may be smaller than simulation/model uncertainty
parameters.update_policy: Prefer confidence-aware continuous utility; if bands retained, version/calibrate to uncertainty

parameters.parameter_family: state weights, diminishing returns and guardrails
parameters.validation: Required: historical recommendation ranking backtest and parameter-stability analysis
parameters.uncertainty: composite ordering may be sensitive despite correct raw simulations
parameters.update_policy: Move toward canonical calibrated utility shared across decision modules

parameters.parameter_family: dynasty, break-glass, title, playoff and competitive-externality utility multipliers
parameters.validation: Required: canonical utility calibration, historical ranking backtest and coefficient sensitivity/ablation
parameters.uncertainty: high leverage; small probability changes can dominate dynasty value
parameters.update_policy: Replace with versioned canonical utility only after validation; expose raw tradeoffs in the meantime

parameters.parameter_family: counterfactual branch probabilities and decision policies
parameters.source: Known historical facts plus model-generated counterfactual decisions
parameters.validation: Validate factual inputs, no-hindsight information firewall, deterministic mechanics, sensitivity and probability calibration where observable; unknowable branches remain explicitly modeled inference
parameters.update_policy: Preserve functionality; improve evidence and calibration as historical analogues/data expand; never relabel modeled branches as historical fact
